headline: Is There A Risk Hiding In CCC Stock's Recent Quarters?
summary: Revenue growth remains the critical metric for investors monitoring CCC Intelligent Solutions (CCC). The insurance software company posted a 9.8% sales increase in the quarter ended June 30, 2026, slowing from 12.0% in the same period a year earlier. This deceleration matters even after CCC agreed to an all-cash buyout on October 15, as shareholders will retain the business if the deal fails to close. So what is slowing CCC's sales.
